name: genpark-multi-agent-speculative-execution-coordinator-skill
description: Multi-Agent Speculative Execution & Early Cancellation Coordinator. Spawns speculative candidate execution paths concurrently, tracks milestone validation scores, and broadcasts early cancellation signals to inferior paths to slash inference overhead.

tools.name: coordinate_speculative_execution
tools.description: Coordinate speculative multi-agent execution: register speculative paths, update milestone progress, select winning trajectory, and issue cooperative cancellation signals.

path_id.description: Unique identifier for candidate speculative branch.

confidence_score.description: Confidence score for current milestone (0.0 to 1.0).
